C08-M05-L06-F1.title: Escalation criteria: now, to Tier 2, or not at all
C08-M05-L06-F1.caption: A triage finding is tested for hard triggers, then for potential impact, and any escalation is checked for a possible reporting obligation.
C08-M05-L06-F1.alt: Decision graph, top to bottom. Triage finding (validated, enriched) leads to a violet decision box: Hard trigger present? (execution, privilege, tampering, exfil). Yes leads to the dark box Escalate now (page on-call, minutes). No leads to a second violet decision: High impact if real? (crown jewel, privileged, spreading). Yes or undetermined leads to the orange box Escalate to Tier 2 (case queue, within SLA). No leads to the green box Close or keep triaging (documented disposition). Escalate now leads to a third violet decision, Possibly reportable? (CERT-In incident types); a dashed arrow labelled if facts change also runs to it from Escalate to Tier 2. Yes leads to the red box Notify IR lead + legal POC (record time noticed).
C08-M05-L06-F1.note: Escalate on likelihood and impact, not on certainty; the analyst flags reportability, legal decides it.

C08-M05-L06-F2.title: An escalation as a hand-off of ownership
C08-M05-L06-F2.caption: Illustrative message order for escalating the WS-104 case, from the Tier 1 page to a CERT-In report decided by the designated point of contact.
C08-M05-L06-F2.alt: Sequence diagram with four lanes, left to right: Tier 1 analyst, On-call IR lead, CISO / legal POC, CERT-In. 1, analyst to IR lead: Page: SEV1 WS-104 + case link. 2, dashed reply: Ack 08:31Z, IR lead now owns the case. 3, analyst to IR lead: Escalation package, what, so what, evidence. 4, IR lead to CISO / legal POC: Possible reportable incident, noticed 08:25Z. 5, dashed reply from CISO / legal POC to IR lead: Decision: report; containment approved. 6, CISO / legal POC to CERT-In: Report within 6 h of noticing. 7, dashed, IR lead to analyst: Tasks: preserve evidence, watch gopal.

messages.label: Ack 08:31Z: IR lead owns the case

C08-M05-L06-F2.note: Escalation is complete only when the receiver acknowledges ownership; times are illustrative.
